data.body: AC amendment: Add test function test_migrator_skips_rewrite_when_dso_workflow_already_present — Given fixture config with dso.workflow=ci-pr (no legacy keys, LF endings); When migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh --target=<fixture>; Then exit 0, config file unchanged, sentinel .claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated created. This prevents the migrator from incorrectly overwriting an onboarding-written canonical config. Cross-reference: S4 round-trip test (test_detect_round_trip_onboarding_output_accepted_by_migrator in task 3cdb-15fe-dc6c-4a37).
